brief: Pre-counted, from c205 and #129's own numbers. GARDEN_ROWS is 5 and GARDEN_MORE 0.8, so a gardener who kneels should work about three rows of a bed; measured after #129 it works 1.53. gardenerKneel's light-fit charges the second row two full rows plus the shuffle plus the walk back to the door, so on most days the second row is priced out and the gardener stands up and leaves with the bed half done. Re-price the continuation the way #129 re-priced the walk — at the choice, once, against the hour the lawn actually closes — so a gardener who has knelt finishes what is in front of them.
successLooksLike: Rows worked per gardener visit goes from 1.53 to at least 2.5 on a growing morning, measured over ten seeds the way #129 measured presence; the gardener still leaves before lawnGone(); and nothing else on the lawn is displaced — LAWN_CAP's other kinds hold their share AT THE CHOICE.
avoid: Do not raise GARDEN_ROWS or GARD_K: #129 counted the supply and it is not the problem. Do not let the fix reach the walk home — gardenFits bounds the pre-dawn walk at BOTH ends and that bound is load-bearing.
